subject: South Korea
note: Hand-curated from the pinned World Bank series (public/geo/series.json): fertility rate, total births per woman (SP.DYN.TFRT.IN).

claims.text: The World Bank's fertility figure for 1960 was 5.99 children per woman in South Korea and 6.36 in Nigeria: over 5 in both.
South Korea's figure fell to 2.06 children per woman in 1983, about 2.
South Korea's figure in 2023 was 0.72 children per woman, below 1.
Nigeria's figure in 2023 was 4.48 children per woman, about 4.5.
South Korea's figure was 1.23 children per woman in 2010.
